name: prompt-pie
description: Save, find, retrieve, and open Prompt Pie prompts and skills through the hosted OAuth app.

interface.longDescription: Prompt Pie connects Codex to the signed-in account through hosted OAuth for account-wide prompt and skill save, find, get, and open actions. Returned browser links open the owned canvas and focus the selected item.
defaultPrompt: Save this prompt to my Launch canvas in Prompt Pie.
Find and get my exact Release helper skill from Prompt Pie.
Open my Launch canvas in Prompt Pie.
